Requirements and upgrade steps for clawql-mcp 7.0.0 — npm, Docker, Helm, and the optional operator.

| Area          | 7.0.0                                                                            |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Default merge | Cloudflare, GitHub, Slack, Linear, Notion, Onyx (provider: default)        |
| Full bundle   | CLAWQL_PROVIDER=all-providers or helm --set provider=all-providers   |
| Secrets       | Vault-backed by default (requireVaultBackedSecrets: true)                  |
| Legacy env    | CLAWQL_* only — API_BASE_URL, OPENAPI_SPEC_URL, google-top50 removed |
Full IDP lab: --set provider=all-providers or values-idp-full.yaml.
Populate HashiCorp KV secret/clawql/providers and sync to clawql-provider-env before expecting Ready pods. Lab opt-out: requireVaultBackedSecrets: false (not for production).
When using ClawQLInstance, the operator sets ProviderSecretsReady:
documents.enabled: false — default-stack vault keys only
documents.enabled: true — default stack + all IDP provider keys
helm upgrade with default or all-providers
Confirm ProviderSecretsReady=True if using the operator
Downloadable macOS app for provider secrets and Agent Chat — no browser tab, no Kubernetes required for solo dev.

7.0.0 ships the build pipeline (make desktop-dist-mac). Signed .dmg
downloads from clawql.com follow Apple notarization setup — see the design
doc.

| Feature           | Desktop app                                                      |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Provider API keys | Saved to ~/.ClawQL/vault/providers.json (MCP loads on startup) |
| Agent Chat        | OpenClaw bridge + dashboard UI                                   |
| Kubernetes        | Not required                                                     |
Requires OpenClaw on PATH and model auth configured — using OpenClaw with ClawQL.
ClawQL Desktop wraps the same dashboard used in Helm deployments, aligned with 7.0 vault-first onboarding and the opinionated default provider stack — not a separate product surface.
Immutable release manifests for 7.0.0 — GitHub + GHCR anchor (Arweave deferred).

| Field               | Source                                     |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| repository.commit | git rev-parse HEAD                       |
| artifacts.sbom    | SHA-256 of CycloneDX file                  |
| artifacts.npm     | SHA-256 of npm pack tarball              |
| images.*          | GHCR ref + sha256: digest                |
| merkleRoot        | Merkle tree over all artifact/image leaves |
clawql doctor --smoke auto-resolves releases/v{version}/manifest.json when the bundle exists in a git checkout.
